schema: Per-channel paid-LLM budget policy, read by core/llm/client.js before every Claude call of this channel (config/llm-routing.json). Enabling paid calls is a reviewed change to this file, never a runtime flag.
notes: A 'script' here is one Short (<topicId>:short:<version>); maxPerScriptUsd caps every call made for it, retries included, at the reserved maximum cost.
A Haiku 5.5 Short script is reserved at about $0.002 and expected to settle near $0.0005; the limits leave room for script + metadata + storyboard with one retry each.

paidApproval (required as well as paidEnabled): {"id": "<unique>", "scriptId": "<topicId>:short:v1" or omitted for any, "pool": "experiment", "model": "claude-haiku-5-5", "maxUsd": 0.05, "expiresAt": "<ISO>", "approvedBy": "<person>"}. It is single-use once closed in the ledger.
The key is the repository secret <PREFIX>_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY of this channel only. The ledger branch llm-budget-ledger must be initialised before the first paid run (one file per channel).
Application limits do not cap provider billing: set a spend limit on the Anthropic workspace as the backstop.
